meta.name: Actions
meta.description: Keep scripts as your own buttons, menu items and keyboard shortcuts — written by you, your assistant, or provided by the deployment.

panel.title: Actions
panel.userHint: Saved scripts you can run from a button, a menu or a keyboard shortcut. Ask the assistant to create or fix one, or write it yourself.

editor.idHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Cannot be changed later.
editor.label: Label
editor.iconHint: A Phosphor icon name, e.g. ph-chart-bar.
editor.scriptHint: Same language as assistant scripts. Return the value to show; the trigger is in the global `input`.

approve.title: Save this action?
approve.warningAssistant: The assistant wants to save this script as an action. It will run with your permissions whenever you use it. Read it before approving.
approve.warningImport: This action comes from a file. It will run with your permissions whenever you use it. Read it before approving.
approve.warningUser: This script will run with your permissions whenever you use the action.
approve.label: Label
approve.unknownNamespaces: Unknown names the script calls: {{list}}. It may fail.
approve.scriptDiff: Changes to the script (click a change to decline it)

consent.deleteDescription: “{{label}}” will be removed from all places it is shown.

import.done: Imported {{imported}} action(s), {{rejected}} rejected. Imported actions are disabled until you review them.
import.failed: The file is not a valid actions export.

errors.runDenied: You are not allowed to run actions.
errors.authorDenied: You are not allowed to change actions.
errors.notRunnable: This action is disabled or not approved.
errors.idChanged: The identifier of an existing action cannot change.
errors.badId: use lowercase letters, digits and dashes (max 48)
errors.badIcon: use a Phosphor icon name like ph-chart-bar
